name: net_seat_activation_calling
description: VUH-2864, PC1 loopback from FM-00 through the real Serenity door: the host stays on the Station of Calling platform while the friend alone walks the stained-glass path and fights every Dusk group. With seat activation on (the default) each group must appear on both seats as the friend reaches it, and all ten die on both. Control: net_seat_activation_calling_off.json. No warps, protect, synthetic kills or save.

steps.message: FM-00 must load the Station of Serenity on both seats

steps.expr: log_count('[spawnctl] seat-activation requested=1 predicates=1',0)==1 and log_count('[spawnctl] seat-activation requested=1 predicates=1',1)==1
steps.message: the host's seat activation switch and both seats' predicate pins must be as this fixture declares

steps.expr: log_count('control released at=02/21 evt=0 site=tt33-calling',0)>0 and log_count('control released at=02/21 evt=0 site=tt33-calling',1)>0

steps.message: no Calling Dusk may exist before anyone reaches a group

steps.expr: len([a for a in enemies(0) if a.get('objectId')==318])>0 and len([a for a in enemies(1) if a.get('objectId')==318])>0
[[(a['objectId'],a['hp']) for a in enemies(i)] for i in (0,1)]

steps.message: the host must log that seat 1's point started a group

steps.expr: [[(a['objectId'],a['hp']) for a in enemies(i)] for i in (0,1)]
[[(a['objectId'],a['hp']) for a in enemies(i)] for i in (0,1)]
[[(a['objectId'],a['hp']) for a in enemies(i)] for i in (0,1)]
[[(a['objectId'],a['hp']) for a in enemies(i)] for i in (0,1)]

{'hostDeaths':log_count('[enemysync] host death epoch',0)-saved['deaths_before'],'friendHitByDusk':len(log_matches(r'\[hit\] .*attacker=M_EX990 .*-> victim=P_EX110',1)),'hostSeat':log_count('[spawnctl] seat-activation side=host',0),'clientSeat':log_count('[spawnctl] seat-activation side=client',1),'lastHostSeatLine':[m['l'] for m in log_matches(r'(?P<l>\[spawnctl\] seat-activation side=host .*)',0)][-1:]}
saved['combat']['hostDeaths']>=10 and all(not any(a.get('objectId')==318 and a.get('hp',-1)>0 for a in actors(i)) for i in (0,1))
steps.message: all ten Calling Dusks must die on both seats
the host must have stayed on the platform
